run_Halide_search_evaluate: run the Halide search evaluation to find optimal rewrites for test dataset expressions
run_rewrite_function: run the rewrite function to recursively apply rewrite operations on a tree map expression
run_get_nonterm_idxes: run get_nonterm_idxes to collect all non-terminal node indices from a tree map recursively
run_HalideRewriter_rewrite: run the HalideRewriter to get rewrite sequences and operations for transforming Halide expressions
run_HalideDataProcessor: run the HalideDataProcessor to load term vocabularies, operations, and process Halide dataset batches
